title: Development of Bistable Out-of-Plane SMA Nanoactuators
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: This work investigates the design and fabrication of shape memory alloy (SMA) based bistable out-of-plane nanoactuators for potential applications in the field of tunable photonic devices. Residual stress and shape memory effect of the SMA films form the basis of the bistable mechanism. Fabrication processes are developed for the designed bistable nanoactuators and photonic structures. The results of this work open new routes for the development of SMA-based bistable nanoactuators and their application in photonics.
